request_type should_we_do_social. The 4-week test runs 2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15, with the verdict on 2026-11-16. The pre-registered verdict is: YES at ≥3 qualified coded inquiries (company/ИП + material + volume) with ≥1 reaching an offer or invoice; NO below the threshold after ≥15 posts. Week-0 baseline: 2026-10-12 → 2026-10-18. Constraints: 0 ₸, no prices, no faces by default, no capacity or spec claims without a datasheet. 3 clarifying questions (threshold, who counts as a client, faces) are already queued in the batched owner message and are not repeated here.
The text judge is near chance on Shorts (ρ 0.11 overall, 0.07 retail, n=1,172), and long-form title patterns did not replicate. Rubric scores are priors only, and the batch must be diverse and cheap.

None exist. No learnings are specific to this vertical, so priors are cold-start and every arm is exploration. The 300-view new-account median in the REALISM line is still an assumption.
